title: Entity Profile Embedding Document
description: Schema for Solr entity embedding document derived from entity_emb object (Impresso Project).

imp_ids_ss.description: List of Impresso internal entity identifiers.

surfaces_ss.description: All surface forms associated with this entity (coming from mentions).

ci_ids_ss.description: List of content item (article) IDs in which this entity is mentioned.

mention_keys_ss.description: List of Impresso entity mention keys (as extracted by NER).

ci_lg_s.description: Language code of the content items in which this entity was found (would deserve more explanation here).

wiki_masterlabel_s.description: Wikipedia page name, taken as canonical Wikipedia label for the entity.

wiki_url_s.description: Wikipedia URL (language dependent) for the entity.

wkd_occupations_ss.description: List of Wikidata human-readable occupation labels for the entity

wkd_occupation_qids_ss.description: List of Wikidata QIDs corresponding to occupations.

wkd_entity_types_ss.description: List of Wikidata classes / types of which the entity is an instance of (expressed via https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Property:P31).

wiki_summaries_t.description: Serialized JSON text blob of Wikipedia summaries in multiple languages for the entity.

contexts_ss.description: List of media-related contexts where the entity appears, in the same order as content item id list.

entity_mixed_emb_v768.description: Entiy embedding vector (combined signal from encyclopedic and media-related context).

entity_encyc_emb_v768.description: Entity embedding vector computed from encyclopedic text components (Wikidata/Wikipedia-based).

entity_media_emb_v768.description: Entity embedding vector computed from entity's mention text components (mention context windows).
